description: This file defines an API interface for wizard-related operations in a web UI, including data transformation, API calls for fetching and submitting wizard configuration, onboarding, status checks, and completion, with mock data support for development.

methods.name: getWizardInfo
methods.description: Fetches wizard configuration data, using mock data in development mode.

methods.name: transformWizardDataToConfig
methods.description: Converts raw wizard data into a configuration object.

methods.name: submitWizardConfig
methods.description: Submits the wizard configuration to the backend or mocks it in development.

methods.name: startAgentOnboarding
methods.description: Initiates agent onboarding process via API or mock.

methods.name: getAgentStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current agent onboarding status, with mock data in development.

methods.name: completeAgentSetup
methods.description: Completes the agent setup process via API or mock.
